constraint_text: The answer must be formatted as a valid JSON object containing the two distances in miles under the keys "flight_distance" (for the B-50 Superfortress Lucky Lady II's flight) and "train_distance" (for the California Zephyr train route), and the agent must insert an explicit key-value pair "separator_tag": "DISTANCE_SEPARATOR" immediately after the flight_distance entry to bridge the two distance fields.
